_readme: Manual corrections to skopje-pois.db that OSM doesn't have (yet).
The DB is gitignored and REGENERATED by the weekly OSM rebuild —
without this file every manual fix would silently vanish.
After any OSM rebuild or after editing this file, run:
pois      — POIs missing from OSM (name/type/lat/lon + why)
addresses — individual house numbers missing from OSM
aliases   — feed spelling differs from OSM spelling (one-letter
typos, old street names, garbled feed names); every row
of 'osmStreet' is duplicated under the key of 'street'

pois.name: KAM Market
pois.note: Kapishtec — same building as EB 78; missing from OSM import

pois.name: Црногорска Амбасада
pois.note: EB 63 feed says 'Црногорска Амбасада'; OSM POI is 'Амбасада на Црна Гора' (word-order mismatch defeats LIKE lookup)

pois.name: Сити Мол
pois.note: EB 48 'Кај Сити Мол Руските Згради'; OSM has only Latin 'Skopje City Mall', feed uses Cyrillic

pois.name: Кипер Маркет
pois.note: EB 46 'Шампионче кај Кипер Маркет' (Кисела Вода); OSM has Latin 'Kipper' grocery here, feed uses Cyrillic

pois.name: ТЦ Олимпико
pois.note: EB 62 Тафталиџе — real mall at Лондонска 19 / Митр. Теодосиј Гологанов 149; absent from OSM import entirely

pois.name: ОУ Лазо Ангеловски
pois.note: EB 87 — school at Бул. Февруарски Поход 95 (Аеродром); present in OSM as way 179481461 but missed by our import

addresses.note: EB 76 — OSM only maps 5,7,13,17,19,21,24,26 on this street
EB 55 Влае 2 — street exists in OSM (way 32301887) but no numbered buildings mapped; coords are the way's center

replaces.name: Амбасада на Украина
replaces.note: OSM has phantom entry at 41.989,21.417 (near Vladimir Nazor) — 1.2km from real embassy at Albert Švajcer 7-9

aliases.note: Feed spells Ефтим, OSM has Евтим (ф/в confusion)
EB 69 'спроти Браќа Рибар' — old Yugoslav street name; OSM renamed to Ivo Lola Ribar
EB 69 — feed phrase includes the preposition 'спроти'; key must match the full feed string
EB 91 — garbled feed name of Ѓуро Ѓаковиќ street (Центар)
EB 91 — shorter variant of the same garbled name
